description.en: Experimental visual palette for the Jaguar archetype, emphasizing precision, movement, focus and validated progression.
description.es: Paleta visual experimental para el arquetipo Jaguar, con énfasis en precisión, movimiento, enfoque y progresión validada.
description.pt: Paleta visual experimental para o arquétipo Jaguar, enfatizando precisão, movimento, foco e progressão validada.

recommended: Use gold for validated progress, guidance and controlled highlights.
Use dark tones to preserve visual focus and contrast.
Use amber selectively for movement and active states.
avoid: Do not use this palette to redefine pedagogical word-class colors.
Do not treat candidate colors as canonical until visual homologation.
